G G shows the ore around you through the rock: for 5 seconds the ore of the Mining rows you have on, within 10 m of where you pressed it, draws as see-through shaded surfaces in its ore's colour, beside the outlines. Your character stays clear of them, and very large deposits are simplified so the game keeps its frame rate. GGVeinSurfaces=false under [General] in minimap_config.ini turns them off. They only run on the game build they were made for: after a game patch G G keeps its outlines until the mod is updated.
